# has perceived condition

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasPerceivedCondition`](gmeow-hasPerceivedCondition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasPerceivedCondition>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)

A standpoint-indexed perceived value about the ambient conditions, expressed as a [`SensoryPerception`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryPerception.md) in a [`MentalReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-MentalReferenceFrame.md). Non-functional: multiple perceivers may produce competing perceptions, and those claims coexist rather than collapse ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) -> [`gmeow:SensoryPerception`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryPerception.md)
